claims.statement: The census of record reconciles with itself and the check enforces it: the header states the confined count and names the instrument's definition; the body's resolve.py numerator equals the header's host-inclusive numerator plus that confined count, per scope; the class table sums to the distinct total with INTERNAL - confined = the pinned numerator. The round-99 record, which passes the round-99 check while its header (2645/7624, 2683/8026) and body (2646/7624, 2684/8026) name different definitions, is rejected by the round-100 check.
predicate: P1: the round-100 instrument on the round-99 record (git show 6e63a7dc:corpus/instruments/citation-survival.md) prints `CENSUS-CHECK fail reason=no-confined rc=1`, while the round-99 instrument on the same bytes prints `CENSUS-CHECK pass` (rc 0)
P2: the round-100 instrument on the round-100 record prints `CENSUS-CHECK pass`
P3: the 15-class tamper harness prints `killed=15 total=15` at the landing instrument, with T13/T14/T15 attributed to `reconcile-confined`/`reconcile-body`/`reconcile-classes`
P4: the census of record's `measured-at` is a round-100 revision (a descendant of the round-100 C2 landing) and its header carries `confined:` and the instrument-definition label
claims.kill: any of P1-P4 unmet, or any tamper class surviving, is NOT VERIFIED; no target is narrowed after landing
controls: controls/c1-reconcile-controls-r100.txt (A: round-99 instrument passes the round-99 record; B: round-100 instrument rejects it with no-confined)
claims.do_nothing: the round-99 instrument on the round-99 record prints `CENSUS-CHECK pass` (rc 0) and has no limb that parses `confined:`, the body numerator or the class table; leaving the record untouched meets no part of P1-P4
claims.erratum: C1's P4 parenthetical read 'a descendant of the round-100 C2 landing'; the record was measured at the C2 landing itself (ff267d12), which is not a strict descendant. Fixed by the wave's finding, not by amending the predicate: the census of record is regenerated at the C1 landing 1605775 (a strict descendant of ff267d12) with the identical triple (SKILL 162/732, corpus 2588/7685, lane 2626/8087, host-owned 77, confined 1) and `CENSUS-CHECK pass` (controls/c1-landing-fix-r100.txt). P1-P3 stand as measured. Qualifier from the wave (MutC1Reconcile): the 15/15 tamper harness is a format/digest harness, not limb-coverage evidence - 10 of 12 single-point check mutants survive it and T14/T15 do not isolate the reconcile-body/reconcile-classes limbs; the limbs themselves are load-bearing (m13/m14/m15 probes). Routed to round 101.

claims.statement: The session-cookie separator becomes the bounded union of S140's assignment-context window and a 1-8 byte whitespace run (S152), so the three high-realism classes round 99 dropped are detected again — the Netscape cookie jar (TAB), the jar (space) and the `_geo_` space form — while the twelve window forms and the ten frozen negatives hold; the twenty remaining S140-faithful classes (a newline between keyword and operator, gaps of 9-12 bytes) are stated as a documented miss in the capability row and the entry's Limits.

P5: the capability row and the entry's Limits name the residual bound (newline and 9-12-byte gaps, 20 classes)

claims.erratum: The C2 statement's residual clause is corrected after the wave (predicates P1-P5 unchanged): the residual is 20 matrix cells in two round-98-faithful classes (a newline around the operator; 9-12-byte gaps around the operator), PLUS four classes the 192-cell matrix does not sample and the union does not match: a quote-only separator, a semicolon-only separator, a mixed quote/space/semicolon separator, and a whitespace run longer than 8 bytes with no operator. Measured: the round-98 instrument hits all four, the round-100 instrument hits none (controls/c2-xclass-r100.txt). The 'twenty S140-faithful classes' wording is therefore incomplete and the 'S140-faithful' label is false for those four classes; the capability row, the entry's Limits and the SCORECARD row are corrected to say so. The harm repair is partial, not complete. The wave also measured that the matrix's S140 translation is the superseded MR !151 window, not the pinned `assignmentOperand` (S151): under the pinned class the TAB jar is S140-detectable and some residual cells are S140 detections, so 'S140-faithful' is wrong for the residual label. The predicates are comparisons against one oracle on both sides and stand; the residual wording is corrected in the capability row and the entry's Limits, and the pinned operand class's other delimiters (quote, semicolon, comma, parenthesis, backslash, pipe) plus its 10-byte bound are routed to round 101.
